speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor mechanism avulsion at the distal interphalangeal joint).

The X-ray confirms no fracture or dislocation, but the swelling at the DIP joint following a forced flexion injury is classic for this condition. I will need to examine your finger's ability to actively extend the tip to confirm the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
